objective.text: Add top-level response metadata without placing it inside each resource item.

difficulty.rationale: Place metadata at the response level rather than duplicating it in each entity.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A resource response needs a top-level meta.request_id beside data. Which expression adds it without making request_id an attribute on every item?

options.rationale: additional merges response-level data into the resource response.
Mutating model attributes does not specify the required outer response shape.
options.misconception: Mutating model attributes does not specify the required outer response shape.

options.text: Add request_id to every item’s toArray result.
options.rationale: That places the value in each item rather than as top-level response metadata.
options.misconception: That places the value in each item rather than as top-level response metadata.

options.text: Return only ["meta" => ["request_id" => $id]] from the item resource.
options.rationale: That replaces the entity representation rather than adding metadata beside it.
options.misconception: That replaces the entity representation rather than adding metadata beside it.
